Combat Test System

A PvP fighting game built around the systems clients ask for most: combos, block and parry, dashes and abilities, set in a temple arena at sunset. Combat runs on the server, so it holds up against exploits.

  • Server-authoritative hitboxes, cooldowns and stuns
  • 4-hit combos for three weapons with different speed, reach and guard damage
  • Block, a 0.22s parry window and a posture meter that breaks guards
  • Shield icon over the head while blocking: white in the parry window, red as posture fills, shatters on a guard break
  • Dash with invincibility frames, plus Rush, Shockwave and Flurry abilities
  • 20 animations made with my own IK tool, including a combat stance for each weapon
  • A custom animation runtime, so animations play in the live game without uploading them
  • Particle effects for slashes, sparks, parries and guard breaks, plus hitstop and camera kick
  • Temple arena map, title screen with a logo made in Blender, and training dummies

Stack or Splat

A party game where players take turns stacking objects on a shared tower. Whoever topples it is out. I took it from an HTML prototype to a full Roblox game.

  • Turn-based rounds with elimination, synced between server and clients
  • Power-ups and random chaos events that change each round
  • Coins, skins, a leaderboard and a battle pass
  • VIP gamepass (89 Robux) to pick the game mode and event
  • Tuned block physics so rounds feel fair and fun

Combat Test System / CombatServer.lua
local function applyHit(attacker, victim, o)    if not alive(victim) or not alive(attacker) then return "none" end    local vs, as = getState(victim), getState(attacker)    local vr, ar = rootOf(victim), rootOf(attacker)    local t = os.clock()    if t < vs.iframesUntil then        fxAll("Dodge", {target = victim})        return "dodge"    end    local flat = (ar.Position - vr.Position) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)    local facing = vr.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(flat.Unit) > -0.1    if vs.blocking and facing then        if not o.unparryable and t - vs.blockStart <= Config.ParryWindow then            stun(attacker, Config.ParryStun)            as.combo = 0            vs.posture = math.max(0, vs.posture - 30)            push(attacker, -flat.Unit * 22 + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), 0.12)            fxAll("Parry", {attacker = attacker, target = victim})            return "parry"        end        vs.posture += o.damage * Config.PosturePerDamage * (o.posture or 1)        dealDamage(attacker, victim, o.damage * Config.BlockChip)        if vs.posture >= Config.MaxPosture then            vs.posture = 0            stun(victim, Config.GuardBreakStun)            fxAll("GuardBreak", {attacker = attacker, target = victim})        else            fxAll("Block", {attacker = attacker, target = victim})        end        return "block"    end    dealDamage(attacker, victim, o.damage)    stun(victim, o.stun or Config.HitStun)    if o.knockback then push(victim, o.knockback, o.knockTime or 0.15) end    fxAll("Hit", {attacker = attacker, target = victim, damage = o.damage, heavy = o.heavy})    return "hit"end

Decides what happens when a hit lands: dodge, parry, block, guard break or a clean hit. The parry window is checked against the server clock, so players can't fake it.

local function doM1(char)    local s = getState(char)    if not canAct(s) then return end    local t = os.clock()    local weaponName = weaponOf(char)    local w = Config.Weapons[weaponName]    if t - s.lastM1 > Config.ComboResetTime then s.combo = 0 end    s.combo = s.combo % Config.ComboLength + 1    s.lastM1 = t    local final = s.combo == Config.ComboLength    s.busyUntil = t + w.Speed + (final and Config.ComboEndLag or 0)    if final then s.combo = 0 end    fxAll("Swing", {char = char, combo = final and Config.ComboLength or s.combo, weapon = weaponName, speed = w.Speed})    local stunAtStart = s.stunUntil    task.delay(w.Speed * 0.45, function()        if not alive(char) or s.stunUntil ~= stunAtStart then return end        local look = rootOf(char).CFrame.LookVector        for _, victim in boxTargets(char, 0.5, Vector3.new(6, 6, w.Range)) do            applyHit(char, victim, {                damage = w.Damage * (final and 1.4 or 1),                posture = w.Posture,                stun = final and 0.8 or Config.HitStun,                knockback = final and (look * w.Knockback + Vector3.new(0, 24, 0)) or look * 9,                heavy = final,            })        end    end)end

Each click advances a 4-hit combo. The hitbox fires partway through the swing, and getting stunned during the windup cancels the attack.

local function solveChain(S, T, pole, a1, L2, bendSign, eFallback)    local a1sq = a1:Dot(a1)    local ay = math.abs(a1.Y)    local dmax = math.sqrt(a1sq + L2 * L2 + 2 * L2 * ay) - 1e-3    local dmin = math.sqrt(math.max(0.05, a1sq + L2 * L2 - 2 * L2 * ay)) + 0.05    local dv = T - S    local d = math.clamp(dv.Magnitude, dmin, dmax)    local dir = dv.Unit    local c = math.clamp((d * d - a1sq - L2 * L2) / (2 * L2 * ay), -1, 1)    local bend = math.acos(c) * bendSign    local v = a1 + Vector3.new(0, -L2 * math.cos(bend), -L2 * math.sin(bend))    local vh = v.Unit    local eh = perpUnit(a1, vh, eFallback)    local ph = perpUnit(pole, dir, Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))    local localFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, vh, eh, vh:Cross(eh))    local worldFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, dir, ph, dir:Cross(ph))    return worldFrame * localFrame:Inverse(), bendend

Two-bone IK that turns a hand or foot target into shoulder, elbow and wrist rotations. I used it to build all 20 combat animations.

-- Plays KeyframeSequences straight onto joint transforms, so animations work-- in the live game without being uploaded. Runs after the Animator each frame.local function step(dt)    for char, rig in rigs do        local active = {}        for _, tr in rig.tracks do            if tr.IsPlaying then                local len = tr.clip.length                tr.TimePosition += dt * tr.Speed                if tr.TimePosition >= len then                    if tr.clip.looped then                        tr.TimePosition %= len                    else                        tr.TimePosition = len                        if not tr.stopping then tr:Stop(0.16) end                    end                end                if tr.weight < tr.target then                    tr.weight = math.min(tr.target, tr.weight + dt * tr.rate)                elseif tr.weight > tr.target then                    tr.weight = math.max(tr.target, tr.weight - dt * tr.rate)                end                if tr.stopping and tr.weight <= 0 then                    tr.IsPlaying = false                else                    table.insert(active, tr)                end            end        end        table.sort(active, byPriority)        for joint, motor in rig.motors do -- Motor6D or AnimationConstraint            local base = motor.Transform            local last = rig.written[joint]            if last and base == last then                base = CFrame.identity -- nothing else animated this joint since our last write            end            local cf, touched = base, false            for _, tr in active do                if not (tr.upperOnly and LOWER[joint]) then                    local keys = tr.clip.joints[joint]                    if keys then                        cf = cf:Lerp(sample(keys, tr.TimePosition), tr.weight)                        touched = true                    end                end            end            if touched then                motor.Transform = cf                rig.written[joint] = cf            elseif last then                motor.Transform = base                rig.written[joint] = nil            end        end    endendRunService.PreSimulation:Connect(step)

Blends KeyframeSequences by priority and writes them to each joint after the Animator runs. Animations play in the live game without uploading them, and it works with both Motor6D and the newer AnimationConstraint rigs.

MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(info)    -- diamond packs: each purchase is paid out only once, even if Roblox asks again    for _, pack in ipairs(CFG.DIA_PACKS or {}) do        if pack.id ~= 0 and info.ProductId == pack.id then            local plr = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(info.PlayerId)            local d = plr and data[plr]            if not plr or not d then return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet end            d.diaRcpt = typeof(d.diaRcpt) == "table" and d.diaRcpt or {}            local rid = tostring(info.PurchaseId)            if not table.find(d.diaRcpt, rid) then                table.insert(d.diaRcpt, rid)                CFG.diaAdd(plr, pack.diamonds, "Purchase", true)                fxRemote:FireClient(plr, "confetti")                pcall(saveData, plr)            end            return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted        end    end    if CFG.DONATE_PRODUCT_ID ~= 0 and info.ProductId == CFG.DONATE_PRODUCT_ID then        local plr = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(info.PlayerId)        if plr then            fxRemote:FireClient(plr, "banner", "Thank you so much for supporting the game!")            fxRemote:FireClient(plr, "confetti")        end        return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted    end    return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYetend

Handles developer product purchases. Each purchase ID is stored with the player's data, so a pack is never paid out twice even when Roblox retries the receipt.

local function mergeData(old, cur, base)    if typeof(old) ~= "table" then return cur end -- nothing stored yet    local out = deepCopy(cur)    -- counters: stored value + what this server earned (or spent) since the last save    out.coins = math.max((old.coins or 0) + ((cur.coins or 0) - (base.coins or 0)), 0)    out.wins = math.max((old.wins or 0) + ((cur.wins or 0) - (base.wins or 0)), 0)    out.trophies = math.max((old.trophies or 0) + ((cur.trophies or 0) - (base.trophies or 0)), 0)    out.dia = math.max((old.dia or 0) + ((cur.dia or 0) - (base.dia or 0)), 0)    -- records never go down    out.best = math.max(old.best or 0, cur.best or 0)    -- what the player owns is never lost    out.owned = mergeList(cur.owned, old.owned)    out.cosOwned = mergeList(cur.cosOwned, old.cosOwned)    out.diaOwned = mergeList(cur.diaOwned, old.diaOwned)    out.diaRcpt = mergeList(cur.diaRcpt, old.diaRcpt)    while #out.diaRcpt > 60 do table.remove(out.diaRcpt, 1) end    -- battle pass: keep the more advanced season / level / xp    local oSeason, cSeason = old.sSeason or 0, cur.sSeason or 0    local oldAhead = oSeason > cSeason or (oSeason == cSeason and ((old.sLevel or 0) > (cur.sLevel or 0)        or ((old.sLevel or 0) == (cur.sLevel or 0) and (old.sXp or 0) > (cur.sXp or 0))))    if oldAhead then        out.sSeason, out.sLevel, out.sXp, out.sOver = old.sSeason, old.sLevel, old.sXp, old.sOver    end    if oSeason == cSeason then out.sPrem = math.max(old.sPrem or 0, cur.sPrem or 0) end    return outend

Merges a player's saved data with what changed on this server. Coins earned on two servers add up instead of overwriting each other, records never go down and owned items are never lost.

local function rateOk(plr, key, rate, burst)    local buckets = rateBuckets[plr]    if not buckets then        buckets = {}        rateBuckets[plr] = buckets    end    local now = os.clock()    local b = buckets[key]    if not b then        b = {tokens = burst, last = now}        buckets[key] = b    end    b.tokens = math.min(burst, b.tokens + (now - b.last) * rate)    b.last = now    if b.tokens < 1 then return false end    b.tokens -= 1    return trueendfunction CFG.placeBet(plr, arg)    if typeof(arg) ~= "table" or typeof(arg.target) ~= "number" or typeof(arg.amount) ~= "number" then return end    if not CFG.betsAllowed or betsLocked then        notify(plr, "Bets are closed for this turn")        return    end    local amount = math.floor(arg.amount)    if not table.find(CFG.BET_AMOUNTS, amount) then return end    local d = data[plr]    if not d then return end    local target = nil    for _, p in ipairs(CFG.aliveNow or {}) do        if p.UserId == arg.target then target = p end    end    if not target then return end    local old = bets[plr]    if (d.coins + (old and old.amount or 0)) < amount then        notify(plr, "Not enough coins. Keep playing!")        return    end    if old then coinsDelta(plr, old.amount) end    coinsDelta(plr, -amount)    bets[plr] = {target = target.UserId, amount = amount, mult = ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute("BetMult") or 2}    setBetInfo(plr, bets[plr])end

A token-bucket rate limiter for remotes, plus a bet handler that checks every value the client sends before touching coins.
